content.text: ZZAUTOTEST — a disposable probe, not a defect report.

This ticket was created on 6 August 2026 for one purpose: to find out whether Jira allows a ticket of this kind to be given a Story as its parent. It does. Creating it this way succeeded, while the identical request naming the epic as the parent was refused. That answer is now part of how we file defect tickets.

It describes no fault in the product, and nobody is being asked to look at it. It was closed as OBSOLETE the same day it was made. It could not be deleted because our account is not allowed to delete Jira issues, so it stays on the record as a closed probe.
Source — none, and none is claimed. This is a probe of how Jira itself behaves, not a defect, so no product requirement stands behind it.
